messages.content: You read English only. If this post is written to one particular person (an email, a letter, a direct message), you are that person (Warrior Cats fans on r/WarriorCats), reading what was written to you; otherwise you are a regular on Reddit question post.

I’m on the early chapters of Darktail’s Judgment, and I get a little bit confused about why StarClan didn’t show up when Darkpaw was at the moonstone and he went really miserable and furious for that.

Ravenpaw said StarClan had travelled with the Clans and left the forest skies, and it would be too hard to get back here for a distant little kittypet who wanted to join the Clans. But it was mentioned in the book that it was an overcast day, so without the moonlight it makes sense they couldn’t reach StarClan back then when the Clans were still in the forest. (Could someone tell me if there was a similar case in the other books where the night sky was cloudy when some cat’s at the Moonstone? Or do StarClan have the power to clear the clouds if they want to communicate?)

And Darkpaw didn’t try again on a clear day; he just chose to transform himself into Darktail👿 instead.

You just read this post. Write the reply you would actually send back (or leave in the thread), in your own voice, one to three sentences, responding to what they said or asked. Reply with the reply only.

result.text: Good catch on the moonlight detail, since it's one of the few explanations the series gives for StarClan going silent. As far as I remember, cats usually reach StarClan at the Moonstone only under a clear moon, and I can't think of a clear case where StarClan pushes through clouds to answer someone. Either way, Darkpaw's choice to become Darktail was his own decision, and it's the bigger turning point in that part of the book.
